title: When the Homecoming Wakes
author: Quentin Amberdale
blurb: Vesper Underhill, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
